# Ko-fi symbol

Official symbol downloaded from the Ko-fi Creator Kit on 2026-10-24:
https://more.ko-fi.com/brand-assets

Original asset: https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5c14e387dab576fe667689cf/670f5a01229bf8a18f97a3c1_favion.avif

`official-symbol.avif` is the unchanged original. The Android resource
`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/kofi_symbol.png` is a PNG format conversion
without changes to the logo. Ko-fi names and marks belong to their respective
owners; they are used to identify the voluntary external support link.
The AGPL licence of Portylus does not grant rights in those trademarks.
